comment: An agent-written game main menu: a gradient page centering a translucent card (flex), custom properties and calc(), letter-spacing/uppercase title with a glow, a flex column of links with a ::before accent bar faded in and a translateX on :hover (transitions captured at the end), a gradient primary item. Text-heavy (boxes are the oracle): the glyph rasterization differs from Chromium's (FreeType hinting, synthetic bold outline vs bitmap dilation); the page without its text is gated at the strict metric (noText).
